versions.changelog:
- Added comprehensive guidance for migrating encoder-only vision models (e.g., YOLO, ResNet, UNet) to Ascend NPU using torch_npu and msprof.
- Detailed step-by-step workflow: model structure analysis, migration verification, performance profiling, bottleneck identification, and optimization recommendations.
- Clarified supported model types and scenarios; excludes decoder-only large language models.
- Provided sample scripts and environment setup instructions for migration and verification.
- Listed common triggers and user phrase examples to assist in skill activation.
